objective: Continue the RA2 strategic-bot build line in bindery-ra2-adapter along the operator's tiered pipeline: tier 1 an in-process LLM plays (cheap tier: gpt-6-luna via OpenCode Go), tier 2 its captured decisions are compiled into phased playbooks (`arena induce`), tier 3 proven playbooks run deterministically (`--arms pinned:<id>`). Near term: land PR #42 (inducer + pinned arm), collect Luna decision data on TRAINING maps, induce playbooks, then a pre-registered held-out test of pinned:<induced> vs selector and Luna.
constraints: Long runs (over ~1 h) must name the decision they inform, be preceded by a ~30-min pilot, be interleaved and resumable (--interleave, --resume), and the operator is told up front if the machine must stay on overnight.

Claude API spend is limited: do not use the Anthropic API key (~/.config/bindery-arena.key) for arena play. Use gpt-6-luna through OpenCode Go (flat plan) via the local forwarder, or the free deterministic arms. Kimi K2.7 Code is unusable (timeouts). The OpenAI key in ~/.config/bindery-openai.key has no Decisions API access yet; its docs are not public.
Never print keys. Scripts that read keys live in the scratchpad as ocgo_* or decisions_* (operator-approved permission rules in /projects/dev/.claude/settings.local.json).
Commits, pushes, merges and deploys are explicitly approved. Every PR gets an independent Opus review posted as a comment before merge; merge only on green CI (Windows included), with a merge commit.

Implementation goes to Sonnet 5.5 workers in worktrees; Opus 5.5 reviews. Worker worktree isolation follows the session's primary directory: dispatch builders from a session rooted in bindery-ra2-adapter, or create the worktree yourself and pass its path.

Do not tune on held-out data: held-out maps are open-steppe and fortress-choke, held-out opponents are ai-horde and ai-armor. Values are fixed before a registered run, and a decision rests on the cells the pre-registration names.
tools/Bindery.Ra2.Bot.Baseline is frozen and must not change; it compiles against the live Contracts, so contract changes stay additive.
Local main of /projects/dev/bindery-ra2-adapter is 122 behind origin and has an untracked .claude/; other sessions use that checkout. Do not reset or pull it; work in worktrees off origin/main.
